topic: Safety habit: what NOT to paste into a chat, and what incognito chat really does
post:
Beginner mistake: pasting EVERYTHING into an AI chat. 🔐
Here's a simple habit for sensitive info, plus what incognito chat really does.

The habit: share only what the task needs.

Before you paste, remove 👇
❌ Passwords and login codes
❌ Full account or ID numbers
❌ Other people's private details

Claude can still help with "[client name]" or "account ending 1234". ✅

Now, incognito chat.
In Claude, tap the ghost icon when you start a new chat. 👻

What it DOES, per Claude's help center:
✅ Keeps the chat out of your chat history
✅ Keeps it out of Claude's memory

What it does NOT do:
⚠️ It's not "nothing is stored". Incognito chats are still kept for 30 days by default.

So incognito is great when you don't want a chat shaping future ones. It's not a reason to paste a password.

Good to know: incognito isn't available inside projects.

Why it matters:
The safest information is the information you never shared. 💡

What's one thing you'd never paste into an AI chat? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.

#Claude #AI #AIForBeginners #Productivity
